hero.title: Beauty, luxury & calmness — without excessive noise.
hero.lede: Peace Fashion Hub is a Lagos house of African luxury fashion. Every gown begins as a quiet idea and is draped, beaded and finished by hand — then worn at celebrations across Nigeria and around the world.
hero.fact3: By hand Beaded & draped to order
collections.title: Three worlds, one quiet standard
collections.intro: From the aisle to the owambe to the everyday wardrobe — each collection is cut from the same cloth: a high-quality base, careful draping, and finishing done entirely by hand.
collections.bridal.title: Bridal
collections.bridal.text: Wedding gowns made for one woman, one day, one unforgettable entrance — lace, beadwork and silhouettes that carry both tradition and modern grace.
collections.occasion.title: Aso-Ebi & Occasion
collections.occasion.text: For the celebrations that fill the calendar — aso-ebi, birthdays, galas and red carpets. Pieces made in Lagos and shipped to wherever the party is, including the USA.
collections.poise.title: The Poise Collection
collections.poise.text: Ready-to-wear with a bold Afrocentric spirit, led by the flagship Virelle Dress. Composure you can wear — designed to be reached for again and again.
pieces.title: Created a masterpiece
pieces.intro: Real pieces from the house, as shared on Instagram — each one commissioned, made by hand in the Lagos atelier, and finished with love, with its name tagged above each piece. Tap any piece to see it up close.
about.title: The woman behind the hub
about.bio1: Peaceful Peace — Peace — is the founder and creative director of Peace Fashion Hub. From her Lagos boutique and atelier, she designs and makes bespoke, bridal and ready-to-wear pieces for women who want to arrive quietly and be remembered loudly — and she models her own gowns, so every design is first proven on the designer herself.
about.bio2: A fashion brand that creates exquisite outfits for women; custom-made outfits, Afrocentric designs, worldwide shipping.
about.quote: “Beauty, luxury, and calmness — without excessive noise.” Peace, on her design philosophy
about.method: Her method is patient: begin with a high-quality base, drape the matching wrapper with care, and place each motif — often shaped like love — exactly where it belongs. Nothing shouts. Everything shines.
about.credits: On set with the house — makeup @_ray_glam · gele @exquisite__gele · film @reelsbynaza
atelier.title: Made with love in Lagos, worn everywhere
atelier.intro: Every commission follows the same unhurried path — from first conversation to a finished piece that crosses oceans.
atelier.step1.title: The Conversation
atelier.step1.text: It starts with a message. You share the occasion, the dream and the date — Peace shapes the first idea with you, one-to-one.
atelier.step2.title: Base & Drape
atelier.step2.text: A high-quality base is chosen first; then the silhouette is built and the matching wrapper draped by hand until the line sits exactly right.
atelier.step3.title: Beadwork & Motif
atelier.step3.text: Beads, sequins and lace are placed one by one — geometric patterns, peacock feathers, love-shaped motifs — until the surface comes alive.
atelier.step4.title: Fit & Flight
atelier.step4.text: The finished piece is fitted, perfected and sent on its way — across Lagos, across Nigeria, and as far as the USA.
atelier.note: “Dress made with love” — the note that travels with her pieces.
academy.title: Learn the craft, the Peace way
academy.intro: The house teaches as beautifully as it makes. At Peace Fashion Academy, student designers learn the full craft — then take to the stage to showcase their own work at graduation.
academy.item1: Cohorts Intakes run through the year — including the January–June cohort
academy.item2: Showcase Students present their own designs as part of the programme
academy.item3: Graduation Celebrated in style — the February 2026 ceremony was held at Queens Court
academy.item4: Register Send a direct message on Instagram to ask about the next intake
voices.title: Loved, out loud
voices.intro: Real comments from the house's Instagram — unedited, unprompted.
contact.title: Your masterpiece begins with a conversation.
contact.text: Every Peace Fashion Hub piece is made to order. Send a direct message with your occasion and your date — and let the atelier begin.
